summary.title: How am I doing?
summary.referenceNote: Standard/global rates at the reference date applied to past usage, not historical billed prices or subscription charges.
summary.referenceAssumptions: Short cache-write TTL is assumed when unknown. No fast-mode, batch discount or geographic premium is inferred.
summary.stalePricing_one: {{formatted}} usage turn needs repricing; its stored computed cost is excluded. Rerun:
summary.stalePricing_other: {{formatted}} usage turns need repricing; their stored computed costs are excluded. Rerun:
summary.coverage: {{known}} of {{total}} usage turns; remaining cost unknown
summary.missingPricing: Pricing is missing or stale for some usage turns, including unresolved models. The known-cost subtotal is incomplete.
summary.costNote: Amounts sum known costs only. A reported zero is preserved, not a claim of free usage.
summary.issues: Stored ingest issues (all periods): {{warning}} warnings, {{error}} errors, {{critical}} critical. Some data may be unavailable.
summary.error: Summary unavailable. Check the local API and the period (both ISO bounds, at most 366 UTC days), then retry.

empty.title: No sessions in this period

quota.title: Quota status
quota.missing: No subscriptions configured yet: Burn rate explains how to set them up.
quota.empty: Your subscriptions file lists no subscriptions.
quota.invalid: The subscriptions file is invalid: Burn rate explains how to fix it.
quota.error: Quota status unavailable. Check the local API, then retry.

burnRate.title: Burn rate
burnRate.intro: Quota windows per subscription. Providers do not publish exact usage: every window figure is an estimate, adjusted with your calibration readings.
burnRate.error: Quotas unavailable. Check the local API and the period (both ISO bounds, at most 366 UTC days), then retry.

missing.title: No subscriptions configured
missing.body: Create {{path}} with version 1 and one entry per subscription (id, planId, startedAt and the providers it covers in match). Plans and limits come from data/subscriptions.json. Then reload this view.

empty.title: No subscriptions in your config
empty.body: Add your plans to {{path}} to see their quota windows.

config.invalid: Your subscriptions file is invalid ({{path}}). Check that it is valid JSON with version 1 and that every planId exists in data/subscriptions.json, then retry.

limitSource.unknown: limit unknown: add a calibration reading

pace.projected: Limit reached around {{time}} at the current pace
pace.notBeforeReset: Not reached before reset at the current pace
pace.unavailable: No projection: no open window or unknown limit

value.title: Extracted value
value.unpriced_one: {{formatted}} turn without a price is not counted
value.unpriced_other: {{formatted}} turns without a price are not counted

overLimit.title: Usage over the limit
overLimit.empty: No usage over the limit in this period.

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.intro: Enter the % your provider console shows. Readings adjust the estimated limit and measure how far the estimate deviates.
calibration.invalid: The calibrations file is unreadable or unsafe ({{path}}): quotas are computed without readings and nothing can be saved. Fix or move the file, then retry.

errors.windowKind: Choose one of this plan's windows.
errors.observedAt: Enter a valid date and time.
errors.observedAtFuture: The reading cannot be in the future.
errors.rejected: The server rejected the reading. Check the window and the values against your subscriptions file.
errors.storage: The calibrations file is unreadable or unsafe; nothing was saved. Check {{path}} and retry.
errors.failed: The calibration was not saved. Check the local API and retry.

readings.title: Readings
readings.error: Readings unavailable. Check the local API and retry.
readings.deleteError: The calibration was not deleted. Check the local API and retry.

deviation.title: Historical deviation
deviation.needsMore: needs more readings (2 when the limit is estimated, 1 when the plan publishes it)

dailyTokensByAgent.name: Daily tokens by agent

costByModel.name: Cost by model

cacheHitRatioByAgent.name: Cache hit ratio by agent
cacheHitRatioByAgent.description: Daily cache hit ratio per agent over the last 30 days.

activityHeatmap.name: Activity heatmap
activityHeatmap.description: Turns by day of week and hour of day (UTC) over the last 90 days.

toolUsage.name: Tool usage
toolUsage.description: Turns per tool over the last 30 days. Groups overlap: a turn counts once per tool it called.

about.title: About
about.body: A local dashboard to explore how you use AI coding agents: tokens, cost, quotas and profiles.
about.independent: Independent project, built with Gentle-AI and gentle-shell.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.intro: Cost and tokens of each gentle-shell profile, attributed per turn. Estimated attribution infers the profile from the models used by each role.
profiles.error: Cannot load the profiles. Check that pnpm omt serve is running, then retry.

empty.body: Profiles come from gentle-shell sessions. Ingest them, or pick a longer period.

comparison.title: Comparison

git.title: Git
git.intro: Each turn goes to your next commit in the same repository, up to 30 minutes after the session ends; turns after the last commit are orphan tokens.
